mapper.sql: select ttray.id, ttray.code, ttray.area_id, ttray.location_id, ttray.reservoir_id, ttray.type, ttray.status, ttray.tray_category, ttray.label_template_type, ttray.label_template_id, ttray.remark, ttray.create_by, ttray.create_time, ttray.update_by, ttray.update_time, ttray.dept_id, ttray.dept_name, ttray.del_flag, ttray.weight, ttray.max_weight ,ta.`name` as areaName,tl.name as locationName,tr.name as reservoirName from t_tray ttray
mapper.delete: update t_tray set del_flag = '1' where id = #{id}

update t_tray set del_flag = '1' where id in
#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT tt.id,tt.`code` FROM t_task_detail ttd INNER JOIN t_tray tt on tt.id=ttd.tray_id WHERE ttd.task_id=#{taskId} AND ttd.del_flag='0' AND tt.del_flag='0'

select ifnull( tl.id , tt.location_id ) as locationId from t_tray tt left join t_location tl on tt.code = tl.pallet_num where tt.del_flag = '0' and tt.id = #{trayId} order by tt.create_time desc limit 1

select ifnull( tl.id , tt.location_id ) as id,tl.location_type from t_tray tt left join t_location tl on tt.code = tl.pallet_num where tt.del_flag = '0' and tt.id = #{trayId} order by tt.create_time desc limit 1

select tt.id, tt.code, tt.area_id, tt.reservoir_id,tt.type, tt.tray_category, ifnull( tl.id , tt.location_id ) as locationId from t_tray tt left join t_location tl on tt.code = tl.pallet_num where tt.del_flag = '0' and tt.id = #{trayId} order by tt.create_time desc limit 1

select ttray.id, ttray.code, ttray.area_id, ttray.location_id, ttray.reservoir_id, ttray.type, ttray.status, ttray.tray_category, ttray.label_template_type, ttray.label_template_id, ttray.remark, ttray.create_by, ttray.create_time, ttray.update_by, ttray.update_time, ttray.dept_id, ttray.dept_name, ttray.del_flag, ttray.weight, ttray.max_weight, tl.name as locationName,tl.goods_allocation_status,tl.pallet_num,tl.location_type from t_tray ttray left join t_location tl on ttray.location_id = tl.id where ttray.del_flag = '0'
and ttray.id = #{trayId} and ttray.code = trim(#{trayCode})
limit 1

select ttray.code from t_tray ttray where ttray.del_flag = '0' and ttray.tray_category = #{trayCategory} and SUBSTR(code,2,LENGTH(`code`)-1)+0 >= #{startNo}+0 and SUBSTR(code,2,LENGTH(`code`)-1)+0 <= #{endNo}+0

select ttray.id, ttray.code, ttray.area_id, ttray.location_id, ttray.reservoir_id, ttray.type, ttray.status, ttray.tray_category, ttray.label_template_type, ttray.label_template_id, ttray.remark, ttray.create_by, ttray.create_time, ttray.update_by, ttray.update_time, ttray.dept_id, ttray.dept_name, ttray.del_flag, ttray.weight, ttray.max_weight, tl.name as locationName,tl.goods_allocation_status,tl.pallet_num from t_tray ttray left join t_location tl on ttray .location_id = tl.id left join t_task_wcs ttw on ttw.tray_id = ttray .id and ttw.del_flag = '0' and ttw.task_status not in ('3', '5')
ttray.del_flag = '0' and ((ttray.status <> '2' and ttw.id is null and ttray.code like concat('%', #{code}, '%')
#{code}
and ttray.tray_category = #{trayCategory} ) or ttray.id = #{id})
